steps.note: In the stack's environment, then Update the stack. One variable picks the release for every Endgame service. The edge's /health then names that commit as its revision. Not yet run with real credentials (ARCH-008).

variations.title: Going back across a database migration

steps.command: make restore BACKUP=<an archive from before the migration> OPS_COMPOSE="docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml" OVERWRITE=1
output: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml exec -T ops /app/Endgame.Ops restore 20261118T010233Z --overwrite
Verifying endgame-20261118T010233Z.egbk from the bucket 'endgame-backups' at 4b8e2d17c9a0f3e65d21b7c84a9f0e13.r2.cloudflarestorage.com, encrypted before upload...
steps.note: Migrations only go forward, so the older images cannot read a newer schema. Set the tag, then restore an archive made before the migration (OPS-16). Everything since that archive is lost. The id is illustrative.
